method: Coordinate descent over the bark rows against the structure score, no model in the loop and no image inspected. A trial renders the species' trunk still headless at the pinned pose and measures it; a trial that improves the score then pays for the guards - the distance, resolution and redraw numbers the shipped tests assert, computed in the same process at the same poses against the same masks and bounds - and is kept only if they all hold. A row that stops paying has its step halved; the climb stops when nothing moves at the finest step, or when five accepted steps at the finest step together buy under one per cent, or at sixty sweeps.
score: The normalised weighted distance from the still's structure vector to the centroid of its catalogued references' vectors. Weights and scales are stated in crates/telperion-render/src/structure.rs.

rounds.primitive: the column-and-cut network as task one shipped it
the cellular partition: sites scattered in the space the surface passes through
rounds.note: One bounded change, taken because round one's row-only plateau left the oak at 64% of its starting distance. The colour guard was added after this round and the round re-run under it: the numbers were identical, so no step of it had been paying for structure with colour.

rounds.primitive: the cellular partition with its wall widened from 0.14 of a plate to 0.20
rounds.verdict: rejected. The oak reaches 1.3687 and the spruce 0.1929, both worse than round two, and the oak's dark fraction falls rather than rises: a wider wall spends more of the plate on the slope between face and floor, and the auto-level takes the contrast back.

rounds.primitive: the cellular partition, with the sun walk taking three steps over a shorter reach and the oak's directional occlusion row raised to 0.8 so R3's term is visible again
rounds.note: The shipped round. An isotropic partition puts the crest that shades a floor anywhere within a wall, so two steps over the ridge's shoulder stepped across it: the term measured 0.0371 of a criterion of 0.05 until the walk and the row were corrected.

guards: Every accepted step holds the distance, resolution and redraw numbers the shipped tests assert, at the same poses and the same bounds, and may not move any channel of the crop's mean colour by more than six code values or reorder the channels - fn-29's colour is not this spec's to redo, and a score taken on the grey of a crop would otherwise buy a darker furrow with a bluer trunk. The in-process replica was checked against the shipped binaries at the end: it reports 2.3441 / 2.8257 / 1.8028 / 2.9677 / 2.7908 and the test binaries report the same.
